children: Cracker Barrel reported fourth-quarter fiscal 2026 consolidated revenue of $849.3 million and GAAP net income of $12.2 million. Adjusted diluted earnings per share were $0.99 for the quarter and adjusted EBITDA was $62.1 million. The company completed a sale-leaseback of 26 stores, divested Maple Street Biscuit Company and announced a CEO appointment during the quarter.
Total revenue: $849.3 million for the fourth quarter ended July 31, 2026 (down 2.2% year-over-year).
GAAP net income: $12.2 million for the quarter; GAAP diluted EPS: $0.54.
Adjusted net income: $22.4 million for the quarter; adjusted diluted earnings per share: $0.99.
Adjusted EBITDA: $62.1 million for the quarter (includes approximately $9.1 million benefit related to tariff refunds, net of investments).
Balance sheet: total debt of $337.2 million at fiscal year-end and cash and cash equivalents of $36.5 million; consolidated total leverage ratio reported at 1.7x.
Comparable store results: comparable restaurant sales decreased 2.1% while comparable retail sales increased 0.7% versus the prior-year quarter.
Completed divestiture of Maple Street Biscuit Company on July 20, 2026; MSBC locations were sold or closed, reducing total stores to 655 Cracker Barrel locations at quarter end.

Completed a sale-leaseback transaction for 26 company-owned Cracker Barrel stores, generating net proceeds of approximately $77 million deployed toward debt reduction and enabling use of capital loss carryforwards.
Paid down short-term convertible notes: repaid $150 million of 0.625% convertible senior notes at maturity in June 2026.
Board declared quarterly dividend of $0.25 per share, payable November 12, 2026 to shareholders of record as of October 16, 2026.
